blurb: CrossWinds Winery is a family farm vineyard established in the early 1990s with an aviation theme. They produce a variety of dry, semi-dry, and sweet wines from Pennsylvania grapes. The winery hosts events including painting, craft classes, wine and chocolate pairings, and cooking classes.
